request: Complete Mosswater's story art coverage with keepsake rewards, a truthful sealed-well ending state and a sheltered spring target.

assets.purpose: Marked-cup keepsake reward for Mosswater's investigation milestone; not a gameplay inventory item.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE isolated transparent game prop cutout for DropInn Mosswater. Match the three actual style reference images: existing sheep and wolves for the bold irregular hand-drawn black raster contours, and the existing well for simple prop construction and restrained colors. Do not include any of the reference subjects. Deliberately loose, clumsy MS Paint mouse doodle with awkward actual shapes, uneven strokes and joins, natural raster jaggies and very few interior marks. Broad flat bucket fills only. Do not clean into vector art, polished cartoon, glossy mascot or tiny shaded pixel art. Single whole readable silhouette centered in middle 65 percent of a square canvas, minimum 15 percent empty margin on all sides. Clearly recognizable at 64 pixels. Actual alpha transparency around opaque object. No text, numbers, letters, UI, watermarks, background, shadow, checkerboard, gradient, material texture, hatching, small decoration, face or extra subjects. Subject: one small crooked cream ceramic drinking cup with one lopsided loop handle. An unmistakable broad uneven mustard-yellow horizontal test mark crosses the outside of the cup. Plain dark empty interior; no water. Only a single short brown chip on the rim as the funny imperfect detail. Thick black irregular outline, three or four simple broad regions, no writing or emblem.
assets.review: Inspected full-size output against existing sheep, shadow-pack and Mosswater well. Reviewed Chromium at 256/128/64/48 CSS pixels on parchment #fff4d6 and dark #20352f. Intact recognizable silhouettes, wide margins, real transparent surroundings and no visible backdrop or halo. The sealed well retains original identity while boards and a rope X clearly close its opening. Spring pool and keepsakes remain sparse and readable. Source alpha preserved unchanged; every decoded RGBA byte equals the lossless WebP. Live placement and reward integration are verified separately by the parent task.
assets.runtimeEncoding: Lossless WebP; full dimensions, source alpha and exact RGBA pixels verified against PNG source.
